free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0 a month: 1,000 requests per UTC calendar month at 1 request a second, one API key, geolocation and ASN fields, usage alerts at 80% and 100%.
free_tier.notes: A hard cap with no buffer that resets on the 1st; past it, and past 1 request a second, the API answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After. The home page demo allows 10 lookups a day with no sign-up. Starter is USD 9 a month for 100k requests a month; no plan has overage charges.

per_object_cap.stated: single lookups on Free; the bulk call takes up to 100 IPs a request on paid plans only

interface_detail: GET https://api.networkdatalabs.com/v0/ip/{ip} with Authorization: Bearer KEY, POST /v0/bulk on paid plans, GET /v0/asn/{asn}; JSON with location, accuracy radius, confidence, network and traits; HTTP 401 UNAUTHORIZED without a key
chaining: 1,000 keyed lookups a month with geolocation, accuracy radius, confidence and ASN, at 1 request a second. Bulk path: POST /v0/bulk, up to 100 IPs a request, paid plans only; database downloads are announced as coming soon
